Item_K43Power.name: Omnipresent Evil
Item_K43Power.description:
POWER: Omnipresent Evil

Press the Active Ability button to activate Omnipresent Evil. The Slasher becomes invisible and gains Undetectable, but cannot see Survivors or their Scratch Marks. Mist Clouds reveal the location of Survivors who are not moving. Footprints reveal the path of Survivors who are walking or running.

Omnipresent Evil is deactivated by using Jump Scare.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Jump Scare

While Omnipresent Evil is activated, look at a Pallet, Breakable Wall, or Window to quickly move to it and perform a special-break or special-vault action. The Secondary Action button switches the side you will face when performing Jump Scare.

Jump Scare exits Omnipresent Evil mode, grants Haste, and reveals detected Survivors with Killer Instinct.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Throwing Spikes

Grab a Spike from Scrap Piles or Hooks. Hold the Secondary Action button to ready the Spike and tap the Attack button to throw. Spikes are replenished throughout the map when Omnipresent Evil is activated.

A Spike knocks back a Survivor and damages them for one health state.

Survivors will be Impaled if they are hit with a Hook Spike. They cannot heal past the injured state and the embedded Hook Spike will have an Aura visible to the Killer.

Injured Survivors will be both Impaled and Immobilized if they are hit with a Spike and knocked into a wall.

beginner.whatItIs: Pressing the Active Ability button makes the Slasher invisible and grants the Undetectable status, but survivors and their scratch marks become hidden from sight. While the power is active, mist clouds and footprints still reveal survivor motion, and a special ability allows quick destruction of pallets, breakable walls, or windows. Using Jump Scare ends the power.
beginner.whyItMatters: Omnipresent Evil cloaks the Slasher in the Undetectable state while simultaneously removing his ability to see survivors or their scratch marks. The most tangible payoff is the freedom to tear through pallets, breakable walls, and windows mid-chase without revealing position, forcing survivors to re-evaluate every loop. Sight is completely traded for stealth, so mist clouds for standing targets and footprints for moving ones become the full basis for tracking.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Activate it when crossing open ground or after dropping a survivor, since the invisibility is most dangerous when a survivor expects the Slasher to be behind them. Use the obstacle-destroying ability to clear a pallet or wall that would otherwise block a chase, then jump scare the moment a survivor gets close. Avoid holding the power while hunting a nearby survivor, since the inability to see them wastes the window.

Item_K44Power.name: Will of the Gods
Item_K44Power.description:
DIVINE LIGHT

Press the Power button to Charge Will of The Gods and call upon Divine Light, allowing The Judgment to control its trajectory for a moment.

Divine Light passes through all obstacles, at a slightly lower speed.

When The Judgment is ready, they can Cast Divine Light, sending forth, becoming lethal and gaining constant speed, unaffected by obstacles.

The longer Divine Light is controlled, the stronger the Cast action will be, increasing its acceleration, duration, and becoming lethal more quickly.

Anytime a Survivor is caught in a Cast Divine Light’s trajectory, if they are not a Heretic, they gain Heresy and lose a health state.

HERESY

When a Survivor is damaged by Divine Light, they gain Heresy, which makes their repairs less efficient, causing loss of progress on Good Repair Skillcheck.

Heresy will decay over time after Repenting at a Shrine of Judgment, when Liberating Heretics from Exile or when saved from the Exile.

EXILE

When standing over a Survivor affected by Heresy, The Judgment can Exile them or Kill them if they are on their second hook, gaining Zealous.

When Exiled, they gain a Hook State and must dodge Seeds of Punishment, which seek to purify the Exile of their presence. While in Exile, Survivors can use the Searcher’s Pendant to collect Exiled Souls, which grant them bonus protections when saved from the Exile by Survivors who liberate them at a Shrine of Judgment.

ZEALOUS

While Zealous, The Judgment gains the ability to quickly redirect Divine Light after casting it.

Divine Light is also larger and faster.

beginner.whatItIs: Pressing the Power button charges Will of the Gods and calls forth Divine Light, which The Judgment can steer for a moment before releasing it. Once cast, the light becomes lethal and travels at constant speed through all obstacles. Holding the light longer before casting increases its acceleration and duration.
beginner.whyItMatters: The ability to steer the projectile before release gives The Judgment a moment to line up a hit through terrain that would normally block an attack, making enclosed areas less safe for survivors. Releasing it early gives a faster but shorter shot, while holding it builds a more powerful cast with greater acceleration. The tradeoff is that The Judgment commits to the trajectory, so a poorly timed release can waste the whole setup.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Charge the power while stalking a survivor through a dense loop so the steerable phase can thread between pallets and walls. Cast the moment a survivor commits to a pallet or window vault, since the light ignores obstacles and will reach them mid-action. Save it for moments when line of sight is poor but the survivor is clearly moving, rather than using it against someone standing still in the open.

Item_Slasher_Beartrap.name: Bear Trap
Item_Slasher_Beartrap.description:
A large foothold trap made of steel. Traps are found lying around the area waiting to be picked up and set anywhere.

BEAR TRAP

By default, you start the trial with 2 Bear Traps. Find and collect more throughout the environment.

Set Bear Trap:

Press and hold the Power button to set a Bear Trap on a valid location in front of you. A set Bear Trap will immobilize and incapacitate any player that steps on it. A healthy Survivor that steps in a set Bear Trap will also become injured but may attempt to escape the trap. Press the Interaction button to pick-up a nearby Survivor who is Incapacitated by a Bear Trap.

Reset Trap:

Press and hold the Power button while standing near a Bear Trap in the environment to reset it where it lies, if it is not already set.

Setting and resetting Bear Traps grants The Trapper 7.5% Haste for 5 seconds.

Collect Bear Trap:

Press the Interaction button while standing near a Bear Trap in the environment to collect it. By default, you may carry a maximum of 2 Bear Traps at any time.
Item_Slasher_Beartrap.summary: A large foothold trap made of steel. Traps are found lying around the area waiting to be picked up and set anywhere.

beginner.whatItIs: A large steel foothold trap that The Slasher can pick up from the environment and set on valid ground in front of them. Once placed, it immobilizes and incapacitates any survivor who steps on it, and a healthy survivor caught in the trap also becomes injured. Traps can be found lying around the trial area and collected as the trial progresses.
beginner.whyItMatters: Setting traps near strong survivor loops turns their favorite pallet spots into dangerous ground, punishing survivors who rely on the same escape route repeatedly. The trap forces a survivor to stop and struggle while the killer closes the gap, converting a clean chase into a free hit. Since traps are placed and consumed, placement matters more than raw speed, and a miss wastes a setup that cannot be recovered quickly.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Place a trap just before a pallet or window that a survivor is likely to loop, so the moment they step through it triggers the snare. Set one near a generator after hearing a survivor working nearby, since they will predictably pass through the same spot on their next run. Avoid placing a trap in open ground where a survivor can see and avoid it, since the whole value comes from surprise.

Item_Slasher_Blinker.name: Spencer's Last Breath
Item_Slasher_Blinker.description:
A powerful and violent last breath snatched from Crotus Prenn Asylum warden Patrick Spencer. Channelling its energy allows The Nurse to pierce and jump through the spirit world in a Blink multiple times in a row. Doing so leaves her in a state of fatigue.

Grants the Blink.Grants 1 additional Chain Blink.Attacks made after a Blink but before the ensuing fatigue are special attacks.After a Blink but before the ensuing fatigue, The Nurse can interrupt and grab Survivors.
Item_Slasher_Blinker.summary: A powerful and violent last breath snatched from Crotus Prenn Asylum warden Patrick Spencer. Channelling its energy allows The Nurse to pierce and jump through the spirit world in a Blink multiple times in a row. Doing so leaves her in a state of fatigue.

beginner.whatItIs: A power that lets The Nurse jump forward through the spirit world in a Blink, chaining multiple Blinks in a row before entering a state of fatigue. During the brief window after each Blink and before the fatigue arrives, attacks become special attacks and The Nurse can interrupt or grab a survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blinking removes distance and terrain from the equation, so a survivor hiding behind pallets or in a tight loop is no longer safe from a direct approach. The special-attack window after a Blink means The Nurse can punish a survivor who tries to vault away or heal, turning their escape into a hit. The fatigue state that follows limits how often the power can be leaned on, so each Blink chain has to land where it counts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Chain a Blink the instant a survivor vaults a pallet or window, since the spirit-world jump ignores the obstacle and the follow-up special attack catches them mid-motion. Use it to close a long gap when a survivor is fleeing down a straight stretch, then wait for the fatigue to clear before committing again. Avoid using a Blink chain into a crowded generator area without a clear target, since the fatigue state leaves The Nurse exposed to counterplay.

Item_Slasher_Chainsaw.name: Chainsaw
Item_Slasher_Chainsaw.description:
The machine gave him a new life, one where the power was in his hands.

Press and hold the Power button to break into a Chainsaw Sprint. Survivors hit during a Chainsaw Sprint are put into the dying state. Hitting a dropped pallet or breakable wall will special-break it.

Revving the chainsaw, and sprinting each cause the Overdrive meter to increase. The meter decreases when the chainsaw is not in use.

When the meter is full, the chainsaw goes into Overdrive.

SPECIAL STATE: OVERDRIVE

While in Overdrive, the chainsaw is enhanced. Chainsaw Charge and Sprint speeds are increased, and Chainsaw Sprint cooldowns are reduced.

Overdrive lasts for 20 seconds.
Item_Slasher_Chainsaw.summary: The machine gave him a new life, one where the power was in his hands.

beginner.whatItIs: Holding the Power button activates a Chainsaw Sprint in which the killer moves at high speed, and any survivor hit during the sprint is sent directly into the dying state. The chainsaw also special-breaks dropped pallets and breakable walls it collides with, and both revving and sprinting fill an Overdrive meter. When the meter is full, the chainsaw enters the Overdrive state.
beginner.whyItMatters: The Chainsaw Sprint turns a straight chase into a one-hit kill, since a survivor who is hit mid-sprint does not land injured but dying. Special-breaking obstacles on contact means the killer can push through a wall of pallets without stopping, keeping pressure on a fleeing survivor. The Overdrive meter adds a second layer of escalation, but it drains when the chainsaw is not in use, so the power rewards sustained aggression rather than brief bursts.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Hold the Power button once a survivor is committed to a long straight run, since the sprint speed and one-hit-kill window are most punishing in open ground. Use it to push through a dropped pallet or breakable wall rather than stopping to break it manually, keeping the chase momentum alive. Watch the Overdrive meter and avoid sprinting in short bursts, since the meter drains whenever the chainsaw is not actively in use and a full meter is what unlocks the Overdrive state.

Item_Slasher_CloakBell.name: Wailing Bell
Item_Slasher_CloakBell.description:
A heavy cast iron bell imbued with ancient powers. Allows its user to enter and walk the spirit world when rung.

WAILING BELL

Press and hold the Power button to Cloak. Press and hold the Power button again while Cloaked to Uncloak, granting a 1 second burst of speed upon reappearing. The Wailing Bell can be heard up to a distance of 24 meters.

Cloak:

While Cloaked, The Wraith is granted increased movement speed, near total invisibility, and the Undetectable status effect. The Wraith may not attack while Cloaked, but can interact with environmental objects.
Item_Slasher_CloakBell.summary: A heavy cast iron bell imbued with ancient powers. Allows its user to enter and walk the spirit world when rung.

beginner.whatItIs: A heavy cast iron bell carries The Wraith into the spirit world. Cloaking speeds him up, hides him almost completely and hands him Undetectable, while uncloaking brings him back with a brief burst of pace. The ringing travels, so anyone listening for it gets a warning.
beginner.whyItMatters: The cloak lets The Wraith reposition across the map without survivors being able to track their position, which is especially dangerous when a survivor is healing or working a generator in the open. The speed burst on uncloaking closes the final gap and makes a lunging hit harder to dodge. The tradeoff is that the bell is audible, so survivors nearby can hear The Wraith coming and prepare a counter.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Cloak while approaching a generator from a distance, then uncloak the moment The Wraith is within attack range so the speed burst carries them into a hit before the survivor can react. Use the cloak to reposition after a missed attack, since the Undetectable state lets The Wraith reset the chase without being seen. Avoid cloaking when a survivor is already in a tight pallet loop, since they can use the audible bell to track The Wraith's general direction and bait the uncloak.

Item_Slasher_DreamInducer.name: Dream Demon
Item_Slasher_DreamInducer.description:
All Survivors have a Sleep Meter that fills over time; once filled, Survivors fall asleep and enter the Dream World, where they are afflicted with the Oblivious status effect. Hitting an awake Survivor with a basic attack will also send them to the Dream World. Survivors can wake by failing Skill Checks, having an awake Survivor perform the Wake Up action, or using alarm clocks that also provide temporary immunity to sleep.

Awake Survivors hear The Nightmare's Terror Radius and see him within 16 meters, intermittently see him from 16 to 32 meters, and cannot see him beyond that.

SPECIAL ABILITY: DREAM SNARES AND DREAM PALLETS

While selected, press the Power button to charge a Dream Snare, and press the Attack button to release it. Dream Snares move quickly in a straight line, through walls but not over ledges. Survivors hit by the Dream Snare add time to their Sleep Meter if they are awake, while Sleeping Survivors will be Hindered by 12%.

While selected, press the Power button to summon a Dream Pallet at a valid pallet location. Press the Power button while targeting a Dream Pallet to rupture it. Survivors hit by the rupture add time to their Sleep Meter if awake, while sleeping Survivors will be injured.

SPECIAL ABILITY: DREAM PROJECTION

Hold the Ability button to teleport to a generator or Survivor performing a healing action in the Dream World. Upon teleporting, all nearby Survivors add time to their Sleep Meter and are temporarily revealed with Killer Instinct. For each Survivor in the Dream World, the cooldown is reduced by 15%.
Item_Slasher_DreamInducer.summary: All Survivors have a Sleep Meter that fills over time; once filled, Survivors fall asleep and enter the Dream World, where they are afflicted with the Oblivious status effect. Hitting an awake Survivor with a basic attack will also send them to the Dream World. Survivors can wake by failing Skill…

beginner.whatItIs: Everyone in the trial carries a Sleep Meter, and when it tops out they drop into the Dream World wearing Oblivious. A basic attack on someone still awake sends them under straight away. Getting out again means botching a Skill Check, being roused by a teammate, or reaching an alarm clock, which also buys a short immunity.
beginner.whyItMatters: The Sleep Meter means survivors are not always fully present in the real world, so a killer who times their approach against a sleeping survivor can land a hit without a fair chase. The Oblivious status while in the Dream World leaves a sleeping survivor less responsive, making them an easier target. The alarm clock and Wake Up action give survivors a way to snap back, so the power works best against survivors who are caught alone or unaware.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Track the Sleep Meter on a lone survivor and strike the moment they fall asleep, since the Oblivious state gives The Nightmare a clean window to land a hit. Use a basic attack to send an awake survivor into the Dream World when they are cornered near a pallet, forcing them to deal with the disorientation while The Nightmare follows up. Avoid relying on the sleep effect against a group of survivors who can wake each other, since the Wake Up action undoes the setup.

Item_Slasher_Frenzy.name: Feral Frenzy
Item_Slasher_Frenzy.description:
They were a plain group of friends until Frank formed them into a Legion. Now they draw power from the thrilling freedom of not abiding by any rule but their own.

FERAL FRENZY

Trigger Feral Frenzy to run at a high speed and chain attacks between multiple Survivors. When your power gauge is full, press the Power button to initiate Feral Frenzy. While Feral Frenzy is active, The Legion moves faster and gains access to additional abilities: Pallet Vault and Feral Slash.

SPECIAL ABILITY: PALLET VAULT

Press the Interaction button while Feral Frenzy is active, to special-vault a dropped pallet.

SPECIAL ATTACK: FERAL SLASH

Press the Attack button while Feral Frenzy is active to perform a Feral Slash. Hitting a Survivor with Feral Slash puts the Survivor into the injured state, inflicts the Deep Wound status effect, and refills The Legion’s power gauge. Additionally, any Survivors within the Terror Radius not afflicted by the Deep Wound status effect are indicated by Killer Instinct. If a Survivor hit by Feral Slash is already afflicted by the Deep Wound status effect, Feral Frenzy ends immediately. Each successful Feral Slash that does not end Feral Frenzy increases The Legion’s movement speed by 0.24m/s for the remainder of Feral Frenzy. The fifth consecutive Feral Slash will put any Survivor into the dying state. The fifth successful Feral Slash always ends Feral Frenzy.
Item_Slasher_Frenzy.summary: They were a plain group of friends until Frank formed them into a Legion. Now they draw power from the thrilling freedom of not abiding by any rule but their own.

beginner.whatItIs: When the power gauge is full, pressing the Power button triggers Feral Frenzy, which lets The Legion run at high speed and chain attacks between multiple survivors. While the power is active, The Legion gains access to two additional abilities: Pallet Vault and Feral Slash.
beginner.whyItMatters: The chain-attack mechanic lets The Legion punish multiple survivors in a single burst, turning a group chase into a cascade of hits instead of one-on-one engagements. Pallet Vault removes the usual obstacle that slows a killer down, so The Legion can push through a pallet without breaking momentum. The power requires the gauge to fill first, meaning it is a reward for sustained aggression rather than an instant tool.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save Feral Frenzy for the moment two or more survivors are within range of each other, since the chain attacks between multiple targets are where the power shines. Use Pallet Vault to keep moving when a dropped pallet would otherwise stop The Legion cold, then follow up with Feral Slash on the survivor ahead. Wait for the gauge to fill fully before activating, since a premature trigger wastes the setup and leaves The Legion without the extra abilities.

Item_Slasher_GasBomb.name: The Afterpiece Tonic
Item_Slasher_GasBomb.description:
Throughout his years experimenting with anesthetics and muscle relaxants, The Clown developed several effective concoctions and formulas. He has used his favorite, The Afterpiece Tonic, to great effect, intoxicating and capturing many unwilling victims. The associated Afterpiece Antidote also has useful effects.

Tap the Active Ability button to switch between the Afterpiece Tonic and the Afterpiece Antidote. Tap or hold and release the Power button to launch a bottle.

Press and hold the Active Ability button to replenish your bottles.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Afterpiece Tonic

On contact, the bottle will break, releasing a purple gas cloud that intoxicates Survivors. Intoxicated Survivors will suffer from impaired vision, involuntary coughing, and 14% Hindered for 1.6 second.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Afterpiece Antidote

On contact, the bottle will break, releasing a gray gas cloud which turns yellow upon activation. The Clown and any Survivors who enter an active Antidote cloud gain 12% Haste for 6 seconds. Intoxicated Survivors who enter an Antidote cloud are cured.
Item_Slasher_GasBomb.summary: Throughout his years experimenting with anesthetics and muscle relaxants, The Clown developed several effective concoctions and formulas. He has used his favorite, The Afterpiece Tonic, to great effect, intoxicating and capturing many unwilling victims. The associated Afterpiece Antidote also has…

beginner.whatItIs: The Clown switches between the Afterpiece Tonic and the Afterpiece Antidote using the Active Ability button, then launches a bottle by pressing or holding the Power button. The Tonic is designed to intoxicate and capture survivors, while the Antidote carries its own separate effects.
beginner.whyItMatters: A well-placed Tonic bottle can intoxicate and capture a survivor mid-chase, turning a close pursuit into a clean pickup. The switch between Tonic and Antidote gives The Clown two different tools from one power button, so the choice depends on what the moment calls for. A missed bottle is simply lost, so accuracy matters as much as timing.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw the Afterpiece Tonic when a survivor is cornered or mid-vault, since the intoxication effect is hardest to escape from when they cannot reposition. Switch to the Afterpiece Antidote when the situation calls for its effect rather than a capture, and save the Tonic for the moment a survivor is about to heal or unhook. Avoid launching a bottle into open ground where a survivor can dodge it, since a miss wastes the setup entirely.

Item_Slasher_GhostPower.name: Night Shroud
Item_Slasher_GhostPower.description:
The Ghost Face used to study his victims for weeks, meticulously registering their habits. When the urge to kill swelled, he’d know exactly how and where to strike.

NIGHT SHROUD

Press the Power button to activate Night Shroud when the power gauge is full. The Ghost Face is granted the Undetectable status effect while Night Shroud is active. Performing a basic attack fully depletes the power gauge and deactivates Night Shroud.

Reveal:

Survivors within proximity to The Ghost Face may attempt to reveal him by looking in his direction for a short duration. A successful reveal fully depletes The Ghost Face's power gauge and automatically deactivates Night Shroud. Survivors who reveal The Ghost Face have their current location indicated by Killer Instinct for a very short duration.

SPECIAL ABILITY: STALK

Hold down the Power button to Stalk Survivors while Night Shroud is active. Hold down the Power button while behind cover to lean out and Stalk at a faster rate. Completing Stalk progress on a Survivor Marks your target and applies the Exposed status effect to your Mark for a limited amount of time. Marked Survivors cannot reveal The Ghost Face.

SPECIAL ABILITY: CROUCH

Press the Active Ability button to Crouch. Press the Active Ability button again while Crouched to stand. The Ghost Face moves at a slower speed while Crouched.
Item_Slasher_GhostPower.summary: The Ghost Face used to study his victims for weeks, meticulously registering their habits. When the urge to kill swelled, he’d know exactly how and where to strike.

beginner.whatItIs: Pressing the Power button when the power gauge is full activates Night Shroud, granting The Ghost Face the Undetectable status effect. Performing a basic attack fully depletes the gauge and deactivates Night Shroud. Survivors nearby may attempt to reveal The Ghost Face while the power is active.
beginner.whyItMatters: The Ghost Face gains the Undetectable status while Night Shroud is active, making it possible to slip behind a generator or across a lobby without any audio or visual tell. The cloak shatters the instant a basic attack connects, so the window of stealth is strictly a movement phase rather than something to hold through a full chase. Survivors who are close enough can attempt a reveal, meaning the safest use of the power is at range where no one is positioned to try breaking it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Wait until The Ghost Face needs to cross a long stretch of open ground or shift to a distant generator before pressing the power button, because the Undetectable window pays off most during repositioning rather than in close-quarters pursuit. The moment a basic attack lands the stealth drops, so the whole sequence is about getting to a safe attacking position invisibly and then committing. If survivors are clustered near pallets or walls in the area, skip the activation since their proximity gives them a real shot at a successful reveal.

Item_Slasher_HarpoonRifle.name: The Redeemer
Item_Slasher_HarpoonRifle.description:
The Deathslinger’s ingenuity affords him the ability to Reel in bounties with a unique invention—a heavily modified, hybrid rifle that replaces conventional ammunition with a razor-sharp spear affixed to a chain.

THE REDEEMER

Press and hold the Power button to aim down sights. Press the Attack button to shoot a spear that can lodge itself in a Survivor, allowing them to be Reeled in towards The Deathslinger against their will.

Reel:

While a Survivor is speared by The Redeemer, press and hold the Power button to Reel them in towards you. Survivors may struggle against the chain or use the environment to pressure the chain to break. Doing so will result in briefly stunning The Deathslinger as well as putting The Survivor in the injured state and applying the Deep Wound status effect. Using a basic attack while a Survivor is speared will break the chain without applying a penalty to either The Deathslinger or The Survivor. Successfully hitting a Survivor with a basic attack while they are speared and healthy will also apply the Deep Wound status effect.

Reload:

The Redeemer must be Reloaded after every shot, before it may be fired again. Press the Active Ability button to Reload The Redeemer.
Item_Slasher_HarpoonRifle.summary: The Deathslinger’s ingenuity affords him the ability to Reel in bounties with a unique invention—a heavily modified, hybrid rifle that replaces conventional ammunition with a razor-sharp spear affixed to a chain.

beginner.whatItIs: The Deathslinger aims a heavy hybrid rifle and fires a chain-attached spear that embeds into a survivor. Once lodged, the spear anchors the survivor to the weapon so The Deathslinger can reel them in against their will.
beginner.whyItMatters: A reeled survivor is dragged across the map with no control over direction, which breaks pallet loops and pulls them away from generators or exit gates. The drag works best over open ground, so it turns an escape into a forced march back toward The Deathslinger.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save the spear for a chase where a survivor is sprinting straight toward a generator or a hook and has no pallet left, then reel them off that objective before they can stop. Do not spend it on a survivor who is already cornered, since the drag loses its value in tight spaces.

Item_Slasher_Hatchet.name: Hunting Hatchets
Item_Slasher_Hatchet.description:
A skill taught by her mother and mastered in the wild. The Huntress can hurl Hatchets with deadly precision.

Start the trial with 7 Hatchets.Charge throw for maximum throwing speed.Refill Hatchets at Lockers.
Item_Slasher_Hatchet.summary: A skill taught by her mother and mastered in the wild. The Huntress can hurl Hatchets with deadly precision.

beginner.whatItIs: A handful of hatchets can be hurled from range to injure or down a survivor. The Huntress refills her supply at any locker, so managing supply points is part of the kit.
beginner.whyItMatters: Long-range pressure punishes survivors who hide near generators or try to escape a pallet loop, since a hatchet does not care about distance. Keeping a few in reserve for a hook finisher is a common pattern, while spending them all on generator work leaves The Huntress empty-handed for a kill.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw a hatchet the moment a survivor sprints past a window or exits a locker, because they are locked in their action and cannot dodge the projectile. Hold back at least one hatchet for a hooked survivor so the trial does not end with The Huntress unable to deliver the final blow.

Item_Slasher_K21Power.name: Blighted Corruption
Item_Slasher_K21Power.description:
Pustula serum courses through his veins, corrupting his mind and body, yet granting him unnatural physical abilities.

SPECIAL ABILITY: RUSH

Press the Power button to quickly Rush forward. Doing so consumes a Rush token. While performing Rush, The Blight cannot launch an attack.

Rush into a wall or obstacle in the environment to Slam onto it. If the Rush fails to connect with a wall or obstacle, or if The Blight is out of Rush tokens, he will enter a short fatigue state and begin recharging the tokens.

SPECIAL ATTACK: LETHAL RUSH

Following a Slam, press the Power button to launch a Lethal Rush. Doing so consumes a Rush token. A Lethal Rush behaves the same as a Rush, except that The Blight may launch an attack by pressing the Attack button. Hitting a dropped pallet or breakable wall will special-break it.

Breaking a dropped pallet consumes up to 2 Rush tokens.
Item_Slasher_K21Power.summary: Pustula serum courses through his veins, corrupting his mind and body, yet granting him unnatural physical abilities.

beginner.whatItIs: Rush is a forward burst that sends The Blight surging into whatever stands in its path. Slamming into a wall or obstacle at the end of the burst adds an extra impact on any survivor caught there.
beginner.whyItMatters: Rush closes the distance instantly, letting The Blight skip the approach and land a hit before a survivor can drop a pallet. If the burst misses every target and lands on nothing, The Blight enters a short fatigue state, so a wasted surge costs a moment of vulnerability.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Trigger Rush the instant a survivor turns a corner and is about to reach a pallet, since the burst is too fast for them to drop it in time. Avoid Rushing blindly into open space, because a clean miss leaves The Blight slow and tired for a brief window.

Item_Slasher_K22Power.name: Blood Bond
Item_Slasher_K22Power.description:
Though forever bound through blood & trauma, The Twins have been granted the power to separate from their shared body. Together they hunt as brother and sister, doubling the threat to Survivors.

Blood Bond

Press and hold the Power button to unleash Victor. Swap control between Charlotte and Victor by tapping the Ability button.

While left on his own, Victor will trigger Killer Instinct, revealing to Charlotte the outlines of Survivors who are walking or running near him. Survivors who can hear Victor’s shrieks are susceptible. However, Victor can be crushed by Survivors while Charlotte is being controlled.

If crushed, Victor will re-grow on Charlotte after some time has passed.

SPECIAL ATTACK: Pounce

While controlling Victor, hold the Ability button to charge a Pounce and tap the Attack button to unleash it.

Successfully landing a Pounce deals damage to the Survivor. If the Survivor was at full health, Victor will latch on, triggering Killer Instinct and revealing the location of all nearby Survivors. While latched on, the Survivor will be afflicted with the Broken, Oblivious, and Incapacitated status effects. They will be unable to enter lockers or leave through the exit gate. The Survivor can crush Victor while he's latched onto them by completing the Remove action.

If Victor misses his Pounce, he is momentarily vulnerable and can be crushed by a Survivor. If Victor lands on an obstacle taller than himself, he will be destroyed.
Item_Slasher_K22Power.summary: Though forever bound through blood & trauma, The Twins have been granted the power to separate from their shared body. Together they hunt as brother and sister, doubling the threat to Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: Charlotte and Victor, known together as The Twins, separate into two independent bodies that each hunt on their own. Swapping control between them with the ability button lets the killer switch focus mid-chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: Parking Victor somewhere and walking Charlotte away turns one killer into two sets of eyes. Anyone moving near him lights up through Killer Instinct, so she learns what is happening in a part of the map she is not standing in. Two areas stay under threat at the same time.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Release Victor and then swap back to Charlotte to chase a survivor while Victor patrols a different side of the map. Use the swap when Victor's Killer Instinct spots a generator group that needs a second pair of eyes watching them work.

Item_Slasher_K24Power.name: T-VIRUS
Item_Slasher_K24Power.description:
A virus that causes extreme mutations and can be transferred to others. Heightens aggression and strength within The Nemesis.

SPECIAL ATTACK: Tentacle Strike

Press and hold the Power button to charge an attack. Once charged, tap the Attack button. Hitting a Survivor with Tentacle Strike afflicts them with the Contaminated status effect and increases your Mutation Rate. If a Survivor is already Contaminated, Tentacle Strike damages their health and increases Mutation Rate.

Vaccine found in Supply Cases cures Contamination. Their availability is limited. After using a Vaccine, the Survivor’s location is revealed by Killer Instinct.

Mutation Rate: Your power expands as your Mutation Rate grows. At Mutation Rate 2, hitting a dropped pallet or breakable wall will special-break it. At Mutation Rate 3, Tentacle Strike’s range and movement speed increase when it's fully charged. The T-Virus icon displays the current Mutation Rate.

SPECIAL ENEMY: Zombies

If a zombie hits a Survivor, they inflict them with the Contaminated effect. If already Contaminated, their health will be damaged.

Zombies can be destroyed by a Tentacle Strike to increase your Mutation Rate, and Survivors can destroy them with pallets. Destroyed zombies eventually respawn.
Item_Slasher_K24Power.summary: A virus that causes extreme mutations and can be transferred to others. Heightens aggression and strength within The Nemesis.

beginner.whatItIs: Tentacle Strike is a charged special attack that, on a hit, marks a survivor as Contaminated and raises The Nemesis's Mutation Rate. Striking an already-Contaminated survivor again deals extra damage and pushes the Mutation Rate even higher.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each Contaminated survivor becomes a growing hazard, and the rising Mutation Rate makes The Nemesis more aggressive and stronger over the course of the trial. The power rewards sustained pressure rather than one clean hit, since the real payoff compounds with every repeated strike.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Strike first to Contaminate a survivor who is already wounded, since the follow-up hit on an already-Contaminated target deals additional damage. Build Mutation Rate early so The Nemesis arrives at the endgame with its full strength available.

Item_Slasher_K25Power.name: Summons of Pain
Item_Slasher_K25Power.description:
An extradimensional gateway that leads to pleasure and pain so great it will tear your soul apart.

Press the Power button to create a gateway and release the button to open it. Once opened, tap the Ability button to summon forth a possessed chain under your control. Direct the chain into a Survivor to bind them.

A Survivor bound to a chain is unable to sprint. Their movement speed will decrease further as they’re hit with a second and third chain. Survivors can perform the Break Free action to escape.

Lament Configuration: If left alone, the Lament Configuration initiates a Chain Hunt by summoning chains to pursue Survivors.

A Survivor carrying the Lament Configuration will be afflicted with the Oblivious status effect and chains will occasionally be summoned to attack them. The Survivor must solve the Lament Configuration to end the Chain Hunt and remove the puzzle box from their possession. While doing this, The Cenobite will see their location and be able to teleport to it.

When The Cenobite picks up the Lament Configuration, a Chain Hunt is activated. Additionally, all Survivors are instantly bound by chains, causing them to scream and reveal their locations.

The Lament Configuration will spawn in a new location after The Cenobite or a Survivor has used it.
Item_Slasher_K25Power.summary: An extradimensional gateway that leads to pleasure and pain so great it will tear your soul apart.

beginner.whatItIs: A gateway opens and a possessed chain is released, which can be guided into a survivor to bind them. A bound survivor cannot sprint, and each additional chain hit against them slows their movement further.
beginner.whyItMatters: The chain turns a fleeing survivor into a grounded one, since the inability to sprint makes cornering them far easier. Survivors can perform a Break Free action to escape, so the binding buys time rather than a permanent lock, and follow-up chain hits are what make the restraint sticky.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Summon the chain when a survivor is running through open ground with no pallet ahead, since the sprint lock makes them easy to corner. Follow up with additional chain hits while they try to break free, because each one makes them slower and gives the killer more room to reposition.

Item_Slasher_K26Power.name: Birds of Torment
Item_Slasher_K26Power.description:
From a wellspring of eternal agony comes a swarm of darkness, a wild and ferocious murder of ink black crows.

Press and hold the Power button to charge Birds of Torment. Once fully charged, tap the Attack button to summon a Dire Crow. You can repeat the action quickly by continuously holding down the Power button and tapping the Attack Button again.

When at least one Dire Crow is summoned, it stays idle for a limited time. Spawning a new Dire Crow will extend the time the previously spawned Dire Crow stays idle.

Tap the Ability button to propel the Dire Crows into flight.

Dire Crows can inflict damage for a short distance when flying. This is indicated to the Killer by the Dire Crow's Flight Path.

Once a Dire Crow continues past the Flight Path, it will no longer inflict damage but can now pass through any obstacles and reveal nearby Survivors using Killer Instinct.

In this phase, Dire Crows will create a swarm around Survivors they hit, allowing the Killer to see the swarm's aura on the Survivor. The Survivor can repel the swarm by completing the Repel action or entering a locker. During this time, the swarm's aura is not shown to the Killer.

A Survivor being swarmed will receive damage if hit by a second Dire Crow.
Item_Slasher_K26Power.summary: From a wellspring of eternal agony comes a swarm of darkness, a wild and ferocious murder of ink black crows.

beginner.whatItIs: Dire Crows, a swarm of ink-black birds, can be summoned after a charge and will track nearby survivors for a limited time. Spawning a new crow extends the lifespan of the ones already flying, so multiple swarms can overlap.
beginner.whyItMatters: The crows give the killer long-range vision without committing to a direct chase, which is useful for learning where survivors are clustered before a hunt begins. The overlap mechanic means a patient killer can keep eyes on several generator areas at once.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Release a first wave before a chase to learn where survivors are grouped, then add more crows when the group starts to split up. Let the crows idle while the killer finishes off a hooked survivor, since they keep tracking in the meantime and save a trip back to the generator.

Item_Slasher_K27Power.name: Deluge of Fear
Item_Slasher_K27Power.description:
Through the medium of a mysterious videotape, Sadako spreads her curse to unwitting viewers and causes their untimely deaths.

SPECIAL ABILITY: MANIFESTATION

Before Manifesting, The Onryo becomes Undetectable and invisible to Survivors, but intermittently visible when within 24 meters of them. The Onryo must Manifest to attack Survivors. Press and hold the Power button to Manifest in your current position. Briefly after Manifesting, The Onryo will continue to be intermittently visible to Survivors when within 24 meters. Afterward, she will be fully visible within 24 meters for as long as she remains Manifested. The Onryo can Demanifest by pressing and holding the Power button.

SPECIAL ABILITY: PROJECTION

The Onryo can also take material form by Projecting herself through a TV. Press the Ability button while looking at a powered TV to Project into it, shutting the TV off in the process.

SURVIVOR AFFLICTION: CONDEMNED

Survivors can temporarily turn off TVs with the Retrieve Tape action. At the TV furthest from their position, Survivors can spread The Onryo's message by inserting their Tape, which reduces their Condemned progress; this also turns the TV off.

When the power meter is full and The Onryo Projects, any Survivor near a powered TV will gain Condemned progress.

Hooking a Survivor affected by Condemned locks in 3 of their stacks, making it impossible to remove them for the rest of the trial.

A fully Condemned Survivor is revealed by Killer Instinct and can be killed once downed.
Item_Slasher_K27Power.summary: Through the medium of a mysterious videotape, Sadako spreads her curse to unwitting viewers and causes their untimely deaths.

beginner.whatItIs: The Onryo becomes invisible and undetectable, then must Manifest at its current position to attack survivors again. While hidden, The Onryo is only intermittently visible when very close to a survivor.
beginner.whyItMatters: Invisible repositioning lets The Onryo circle behind a generator group and cut off an escape route without survivors knowing it moved. The brief window of intermittent visibility after Manifesting gives survivors a short clue to its direction, so timing the Manifest matters.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Use the hidden state to move to a spot behind a fleeing survivor, then Manifest the instant they turn to look in the wrong direction. Avoid Manifesting while a survivor is staring directly at the spot, since the brief visibility after Manifesting gives them a chance to react and flee.

Item_Slasher_K28Power.name: Reign of Darkness
Item_Slasher_K28Power.description:
Like a dark thought, The Dredge is difficult to shake. And when night falls, it is nearly impossible.

SPECIAL ABILITY: THE GLOAMING

Press and hold the Power button to activate. Once activated, The Dredge leaves a Remnant behind. Aim at a locker and press the Ability button to Teleport into it or press the Attack button to return to the Remnant. The Remnant is disabled when teleporting to a locker, or when a Survivor touches it. While in a locker, aim at any other locker and press the Ability button to Teleport again. Each Teleport consumes a Power Token. Exiting the locker or returning to your Remnant will activate The Gloaming's cooldown, after which all Power Tokens are recharged.

Survivors can place locks on lockers to slow The Dredge exiting them. The Dredge can break locks by exiting the locked locker or performing a base attack on the lock. Each locker can only be locked once.

SPECIAL ABILITY: NIGHTFALL

The Nightfall Meter builds when a healthy Survivor is injured, a Survivor is hooked, or the Teleport power is used. The Nightfall Meter also fills faster for each Survivor in the injured state. Once the Nightfall Meter is full, Nightfall begins.

During Nightfall, Survivors must navigate in total darkness, The Dredge’s Teleport is faster with a shorter cooldown, and gains Undetectable. Nightfall ends after 60 seconds.
Item_Slasher_K28Power.summary: Like a dark thought, The Dredge is difficult to shake. And when night falls, it is nearly impossible.

beginner.whatItIs: A Remnant is left behind by The Dredge, who can then teleport into any locker it aims at or return to the Remnant's location at will. The Remnant is disabled if The Dredge teleports into a locker or if a survivor touches it.
beginner.whyItMatters: Instant locker-to-locker travel breaks a survivor's assumption about where The Dredge will come from next, turning every locker into a potential ambush point. The Remnant adds a safe recall spot on the map, but it is fragile and must be placed where survivors are unlikely to stumble into it.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop the Remnant near a generator cluster before moving to hunt a different side of the map, then teleport back to it when a survivor is mid-vault or mid-interaction. Use locker-to-locker hops to reposition when a chase has gone stale and the survivor is looping too predictably.

Item_Slasher_K29Power.name: Virulent Bound
Item_Slasher_K29Power.description:
The Mastermind can barrel forward, Infecting Survivors with the Uroboros virus or leaping over obstacles.

Press and hold the Power button to charge a Bound attack. While charging, The Mastermind moves slightly slower as he prepares his strike. When charged, press the Attack button to Bound. If The Mastermind hits a Survivor, that Survivor becomes Infected (or furthers their Infection). Should The Mastermind crash into something during this Bound, he will slam the Survivor, causing damage; if not, the Survivor is thrown, losing a health state if they are thrown into any solid object.

If Virulent Bound hits a window or dropped pallet, The Mastermind will special-vault the obstacle.

SPECIAL EFFECT: UROBOROS INFECTION

Upon being hit by Virulent Bound, Survivors become Infected. Infected builds over time, and when fully Infected, the Survivor suffers from a 4% Hindered status effect. If a Virulent Bound grabs and slams a Survivor while they are fully Infected, The Mastermind will automatically carry them.

SPECIAL INTERACTION: FIRST AID SPRAY

At the beginning of each trial, several Supply Crates spawn. Each contains a First Aid Spray. When Infected, a Survivor can use the First Aid Spray on themselves or another, removing the Infection. Each First Aid Spray has a set number of charges. After using a First Aid Spray, the Survivor's location is briefly revealed by Killer Instinct.
Item_Slasher_K29Power.summary: The Mastermind can barrel forward, Infecting Survivors with the Uroboros virus or leaping over obstacles.

beginner.whatItIs: The Mastermind charges and barrels forward in a heavy Bound strike, slamming into any survivor or obstacle in its path. Hitting a survivor infects them with the Uroboros virus, and crashing into something during the Bound slams them for extra damage.
beginner.whyItMatters: The infection status on a survivor is a persistent debuff that makes them easier to track, and the crash damage rewards aiming the Bound at a wall near a cornered survivor. The charge slows The Mastermind slightly while preparing, so a committed Bound takes time to wind up and cannot be canceled casually.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Charge Bound when a survivor is running straight down a corridor and cannot swerve, since the straight-line charge is hard to avoid in that geometry. Aim a deliberate wall crash at a survivor who is stuck in a corner, since the impact damage on a crash is part of the design.

Item_Slasher_K30Power.name: Guardia Compagnia
Item_Slasher_K30Power.description:
The Knight alone is a terrifying monster on the battlefield, but with his loyal Guards, he is nearly unstoppable. Together, the Guardia Compagnia fights for their own freedom, killing anyone who gets in their way.

SPECIAL ABILITY: GUARD SUMMON

Tap the Power button to activate Guard Summon mode. Once activated, move around to create a Patrol Path. While in Guard Summon mode, you can aim at a generator in progress, a dropped pallet or a breakable wall and tap the Attack button. This will summon a Guard to damage or special-break the selected object.

You can also tap the Power button or drain the Power Gauge completely to end the Guard Summon mode. This will summon a Guard who will follow and Patrol the created Path. The longer the Patrol Path, the longer the Guard's Hunt Timer will be. There are three Guards that can be summoned one at a time: The Carnifex, who can damage or special-break objects faster; The Assassin, who moves faster during the Hunt; and The Jailer, who patrols and hunts longer, and is better at detection.

GUARD SPECIAL ABILITY: THE HUNT

While a Guard is patrolling, he can spot and detect Survivors. If a Survivor is detected, the Guard will move to their location, leave a Standard on the ground, and start Hunting the Survivor for a set amount of time. The Survivor can escape a Guard by unhooking another Survivor, grabbing the Standard, or surviving until the Hunt timer ends. If the Survivor is successfully attacked by the Guard or The Knight, the Guard will disappear. When a Guard downs a Survivor, The Knight receives a Killer Instinct notification.
Item_Slasher_K30Power.summary: The Knight alone is a terrifying monster on the battlefield, but with his loyal Guards, he is nearly unstoppable. Together, the Guardia Compagnia fights for their own freedom, killing anyone who gets in their way.

beginner.whatItIs: Tapping the Power button drops The Knight into Guard Summon mode, and walking from there traces a Patrol Path across the ground. Aiming at a generator being repaired, a dropped pallet or a breakable wall and hitting Attack posts a Guard to watch it. The Guardia Compagnia handles the standing around so he does not have to.
beginner.whyItMatters: Guards lock down a tile and punish any survivor who returns to it, which forces a change of route and opens up the rest of the board. Laying down a Patrol Path takes a moment, so the power rewards committing to an area and holding it rather than chasing everywhere at once.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Activate Guard Summon mode when a generator is close to completion and a survivor is likely to come back to it, then lock the Patrol Path around that tile. It pays off most when the killer has already pressured one side of the map and wants to seal off a specific spot rather than cross the whole map again.

Item_Slasher_K31Power.name: Eyes In The Sky
Item_Slasher_K31Power.description:
Inspired by the dark mangas created by her father, The Skull Merchant relentlessly hunts her prey using the latest in surveillance technology.

The Skull Merchant begins the match with six Drones. Press the Power button to deploy a Drone. Recalling a Drone grants Undetectable for 8 seconds. Once detected by a scan line, a Survivor gains scan immunity and cannot be detected by other scan lines for a few seconds.

Survivors can attempt to hack Drones. Failure partially fills their Lock On meter; Success disables the Drone for 45 seconds.

SPECIAL ABILITY: RADAR

Press the Ability Button to open a Radar to see the locations of Survivors detected by Drones and those with Claw Traps. The Radar can be used to change a Drone's rotation direction or to recall a Drone.

When a Survivor is detected by a Drone shortly after its deployment or change in rotation, The Skull Merchant gains 5% Haste for 8 seconds.

SPECIAL EFFECT: LOCK ON

The Lock On meter fills when scanned by a Drone and when failing to disable a Drone. When the meter is full, the Survivor receives a Claw Trap, becomes Injured, and suffers from the Broken status effect. Additional scans briefly apply a 10% Hindered status effect.

A Claw Trap broadcasts the Survivor’s location to the Killer and is only removed when its battery dies.
Item_Slasher_K31Power.summary: Inspired by the dark mangas created by her father, The Skull Merchant relentlessly hunts her prey using the latest in surveillance technology.

beginner.whatItIs: Eyes In The Sky is The Skull Merchant's power, built around deploying Drones across the map that patrol their area and project a scan line. Pressing the Power button releases a Drone, and recalling it grants a brief window of Undetectable while the killer repositions.
beginner.whyItMatters: The scan line reveals survivors hiding in fog or behind cover, which changes how they play in the area a Drone watches. A survivor who fails to hack a Drone partially fills a Lock On meter, and once caught in a scan line they gain short immunity that blocks other scans from re-tagging them immediately.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Deploy a Drone before a chase begins so the scan line is already watching a generator or loop when the survivor commits to a route. Recall it quickly once the killer needs to break line of sight, since the Undetectable window is brief but enough to escape a tight chase or slip to a new position.

Item_Slasher_K32Power.name: Quantum Instantiation
Item_Slasher_K32Power.description:
A dark crystalline structure in an ancient ruin gifted—or perhaps cursed—Hux with sentience. He built a new body, and with it, a terrifying way to bend the rules of physics to his benefit.

The Singularity can shoot and spawn Biopods around the map; these Biopods can attach to any vertical surface they land on. The Singularity can control a Biopod remotely and look through it, and tag Survivors, afflicting them with a Temporal Slipstream. When Slipstreamed, The Singularity can teleport next to the Slipstreamed Survivor either by using the Biopods to tag them, or by shooting them. When a Slipstreamed Survivor is in proximity to another Survivor, the Slipstream can spread. All Slipstreamed Survivors are briefly revealed with Killer Instinct.

SPECIAL STATE: OVERCLOCK MODE

After a successful Slipstream teleport, The Singularity enters Overclock Mode. In this state, The Singularity gains 3% movement speed for 5.7 seconds, can basic-break dropped pallets or breakable walls and basic-vault windows faster, and cannot be stunned. Attempts to stun remove Overclock Mode and The Singularity is afflicted with 50% Hindered for 3 seconds.

SPECIAL INTERACTION: ELECTROMAGNETIC PULSE

At the beginning of each Trial, several Supply Cases spawn, each containing an EMP. Survivors can use these EMPs to remove the Slipstream from themselves or others, or to briefly disable a Biopod. Once used, the EMP is destroy
Item_Slasher_K32Power.summary: A dark crystalline structure in an ancient ruin gifted—or perhaps cursed—Hux with sentience. He built a new body, and with it, a terrifying way to bend the rules of physics to his benefit.

beginner.whatItIs: Quantum Instantiation is The Singularity's power, which lets the killer shoot Biopods across the map where they stick to any vertical surface they land on. The killer can then remotely control a Biopod to peek around corners, and tagging a survivor with it applies Temporal Slipstream, allowing The Singularity to teleport directly to their side.
beginner.whyItMatters: Biopods act as persistent eyes placed in advance, so the killer has information before a chase even starts. Temporal Slipstream collapses distance the instant it triggers, which can turn a generator run or a heal into a caught moment with no approach required.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Plant Biopods on high walls near generators early in the trial so they are already watching when survivors arrive to work. Save the teleport for the moment a survivor is mid-action, finishing a generator or healing a teammate, so the closed distance lands before they can react and run.

Item_Slasher_K33Power.name: Hidden Pursuit
Item_Slasher_K33Power.description:
Supposedly responding to a distress signal, the Nostromo's crew landed on LV-426. What they found there became one of humanity's greatest horrors.

When The Xenomorph is in a trial, a series of tunnels become available to it. By accessing a Control Station, it can enter these tunnels to quickly move around the map, detect the presence of nearby Survivors, and speed up the cooldown time of its Crawler Mode. Exiting a Control Station momentarily deactivates deployed Turrets and tags nearby Survivors with Killer Instinct.

SPECIAL ABILITY: CRAWLER MODE

The Xenomorph enters Crawler Mode automatically when not on cooldown. In Crawler Mode, The Xenomorph walks on four legs and becomes stealthier, reducing its Terror Radius. While in Crawler Mode, The Xenomorph also has access to a brutal Tail Attack.

SPECIAL MAP FEATURE: CONTROL STATIONS

Seven Control Stations are scattered across the map. Survivors can interact with these stations to get a Remote Flame Turret, while The Xenomorph can enter and exit the tunnels underneath the Control Stations.

SPECIAL ITEM: REMOTE FLAME TURRET

Turrets can be placed in the map to counteract The Xenomorph. When The Xenomorph enters the radius and line of sight of a Turret, the Turret attacks; this attack staggers The Xenomorph and can cause Crawler Mode to end. If a Turret successfully knocks The Xenomorph out of Crawler Mode or fires for too long, it overheats, and must be repaired by a Survivor. The Xenomorph can attack Turrets to destroy them. Carrying a Turret makes you immune to detection while the killer is in the tunnel.

“Its structural perfection is matched only by its hostility.” – Ash, Science Officer
Item_Slasher_K33Power.summary: Supposedly responding to a distress signal, the Nostromo's crew landed on LV-426. What they found there became one of humanity's greatest horrors.

beginner.whatItIs: Hidden Pursuit is The Xenomorph's power, which opens up a network of tunnels connecting Control Stations scattered across the map. Using a Control Station lets The Xenomorph enter the tunnels to move quickly between distant parts of the map, sense nearby survivors, and reduce the cooldown on Crawler Mode.
beginner.whyItMatters: Tunnels let the killer cover long distances unseen, which keeps survivors guessing where the next threat is coming from. Exiting a Control Station briefly shuts down nearby Turrets and tags survivors in the area, creating a moment of pressure that forces a reaction before the killer commits to a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Step into a Control Station when a chase is winding down and the killer needs to cross the map to reach the next target before survivors finish their current task. Use it between chases to reposition quietly rather than during one, since the tunnel path takes a moment to traverse and the killer is vulnerable while inside.

Item_Slasher_K34Power.name: Playtime's Over
Item_Slasher_K34Power.description:
After the rage of being trapped in the body of a doll subsided, the Lakeshore Strangler realized this new body was the perfect host to disorient and surprise his kills.

SPECIAL ABILITY: HIDEY-HO MODE

Chucky can enter Hidey-Ho Mode at any time, provided the cooldown is over. When in Hidey-Ho Mode, Chucky becomes Undetectable and generates map-wide Footfalls, disorienting Survivors with sounds and footprints coming from many directions.

SPECIAL ABILITY: SLICE & DICE

While in Hidey-Ho Mode, Chucky gets access to the charged Slice & Dice ability, allowing him to rush unsuspecting Survivors before leaping forward and performing a Slice & Dice attack. Additionally, Chucky can quickly chain a Scamper while using a Slice & Dice.

SPECIAL ABILITY: SCAMPER

While performing a Slice & Dice in Hidey-Ho Mode, Chucky can perform a Scamper and special-vault over a window or under a downed pallet, allowing him to close on his unsuspecting prey.

“I'm one of the most notorious slashers in history. And I don't want to give that up. I am Chucky, the killer doll! And I dig it!” – Chucky
Item_Slasher_K34Power.summary: After the rage of being trapped in the body of a doll subsided, the Lakeshore Strangler realized this new body was the perfect host to disorient and surprise his kills.

beginner.whatItIs: Playtime's Over is The Lakeshore Strangler's power, centered on Hidey-Ho Mode, which makes the killer Undetectable while flooding the map with false Footfalls and footprints from many directions. While in that mode the killer can also use Slice & Dice to attack from a stealthed state.
beginner.whyItMatters: The false audio cues make it hard for survivors to locate the real killer, so healing and generator work become riskier because the threat could be anywhere. Undetectable means the killer can approach a survivor without being seen, which flips the usual hide-and-seek dynamic in the killer's favor.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Enter Hidey-Ho Mode when the killer is out of a chase and needs to cross open ground or reposition to a new area without being tracked. Use it to stalk a survivor who is healing or finishing a generator, since the footfall noise forces survivors to react to sounds rather than to the killer's actual position.

Item_Slasher_K35Power.name: UVX
Item_Slasher_K35Power.description:
Some believed a specimen was recovered by the military for their experiments. The codename: Unknown Venom X.

Press the Power button to charge UVX. Once ready, press the Attack button to launch UVX, a bouncing Projectile which creates a Blast Area upon impact. Survivors become Hindered by 6% if touched by UVX while airborne.

Survivors touching the Blast Area become Weakened. Weakened Survivors lose health states if touched by Blast Areas. Survivors lose Weakened by successfully Staring Down The Unknown.

SPECIAL ABILITY: HALLUCINATIONS

The Unknown will intermittently create up to 4 Hallucinations. Hallucinations cannot be created while charging UVX, performing interactions, or in proximity to map objects like hooks.

Whenever Survivors are touched by Blast Areas or otherwise become Weakened, the next Hallucination's spawn time decreases by 10 seconds.

The Unknown can Teleport to Hallucinations, leaving behind a temporary Decoy. Survivors can remove Hallucinations from the trial with the Dispel ability. Weakened Survivors take longer to Dispel. If Dispel is not completed, Survivors become Weakened and trigger Killer Instinct.

“... Request for analysis [REDACTED] incident [REDACTED] awaiting approval.” - Excerpt from leaked OSS report
Item_Slasher_K35Power.summary: Some believed a specimen was recovered by the military for their experiments. The codename: Unknown Venom X.

beginner.whatItIs: UVX is a power that charges by holding the Power button, then launches a bouncing projectile the moment the Attack button is pressed. Where it lands it leaves a Blast Area on the ground that lingers and affects any survivor who steps into it.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor touched by the projectile while airborne becomes Hindered, slowing their movement. Once a survivor is Weakened, another touch from the Blast Area strips away a health state instead of merely injuring them, and staring the Weakened state down clears it but costs time and focus that the killer wants to deny.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Fire UVX when a survivor is vaulting or jumping through a gap, since the airborne hit applies the slowing Hindered effect before they land. Drop it in front of a pallet or a narrow corridor so the Blast Area covers the escape route and forces a survivor to either slow down or accept the Weakened debuff.

Item_Slasher_K36Power.name: VILE DARKNESS
Item_Slasher_K36Power.description:
Bound with the skin and flesh of men, the Book is packed with spells both forbidden and wicked.

To select a Spell, hold Ability button 1 to open the Spell selection. The Lich has 4 different Spells:

Mage Hand: Creates a magical hand that lifts downed pallets or blocks upright pallets for 4 seconds.Flight of the Damned: Conjures 5 flying entities that pass through obstacles and injure Survivors.Dispelling Sphere: Casts a moving invisible sphere that reveals Survivors & temporarily disables Magic Items.Fly: Briefly move faster, ignoring vaults and pallets.

SPECIAL ITEM: MAGIC ITEMS

Treasure Chests found around the map can contain Magic Items for Survivors to equip. These include Boots/Gauntlets of:

The Interloper: When Mage Hand is used, reveals aura of affected pallets and applies Haste for 4 seconds.The Nightwatch: Reveals auras of Flight of the Damned.The Archivist: Makes Dispelling Sphere visible.The Skyguard: Reveals The Lich's aura during Fly and for a few seconds after.Additionally, upon procurement, all Magic Items briefly reveal Vecna's aura.

SPECIAL ITEMS: HAND & EYE OF VECNA

Rarely, Treasure Chests contain the Hand or Eye of Vecna. When picked up and used by a Survivor at full health, they cost them a health state, reveal their location with Killer Instinct for 4 seconds, and grant them a special ability.

Hand of Vecna: A Fast Locker Entry teleports the Survivor to a further locker.Eye of Vecna: A Fast Locker Exit hides the Survivor's aura and grants Haste for 12 seconds.
Item_Slasher_K36Power.summary: Bound with the skin and flesh of men, the Book is packed with spells both forbidden and wicked.

beginner.whatItIs: VILE DARKNESS is The Lich's power, built around a set of Spells the killer can swap in and out during a trial using the Ability button. Options include Mage Hand to lift or block pallets for a short time, Flight of the Damned to send flying entities that punch through obstacles and injure survivors, and Dispelling Sphere to roll forward and reveal or disrupt survivors in its path.
beginner.whyItMatters: Each Spell reshapes a chase in a different way: Mage Hand locks a survivor out of a pallet loop, Flight of the Damned closes distance across an obstacle, and Dispelling Sphere strips a survivor's defensive state while revealing their position. The killer swaps between them to match the situation, which keeps survivors unable to predict the next move.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Reach for Mage Hand when a survivor is looping the same pallet and the killer needs to break that rhythm, or use Flight of the Damned to jump a wall and land on the far side of a chase. Dispelling Sphere is best thrown when a survivor is using a defensive perk or hiding in the fog, since the reveal and disruption land at the same time.

Item_Slasher_K37Power.name: Vampiric Shift
Item_Slasher_K37Power.description:
His dark power allows him to exact revenge on humans, taking many forms to terrorize and slaughter them.

SPECIAL ABILITY: SHAPESHIFT

The Dark Lord has access to three Forms and can freely change between them. Each Form has unique abilities and strengths.

Vampire Form: In his default state, The Dark Lord can use the powerful Hellfire spell, which creates 8 pillars of flame that erupt from the ground in front of him and can be cast across low obstacles.

Wolf Form: In Wolf Form, The Dark Lord has access to several abilities that allow for more effective tracking. Pools of blood and scratch marks are brighter and running Survivors leave a trail of Scent Orbs behind them. The Dark Lord can collect these Scent Orbs to gain Haste, and charge a powerful Pounce attack to damage Survivors. Hitting a dropped pallet or breakable wall will special-break it.

Bat Form: While in Bat Form, The Dark Lord gains the Undetectable status effect. Additionally, he moves faster, ignores vault points, and can Teleport to any vault points within 32 meters. Survivors become invisible, but scratch marks can be se
Item_Slasher_K37Power.summary: His dark power allows him to exact revenge on humans, taking many forms to terrorize and slaughter them.

beginner.whatItIs: Vampiric Shift is The Dark Lord's power, which lets the killer switch between multiple Forms, each with its own set of abilities. In Vampire Form the killer can cast Hellfire, which erupts pillars of flame across low obstacles, while Wolf Form shifts the killer into a faster, more mobile hunting state.
beginner.whyItMatters: Switching forms on the fly means the killer can adapt to the shape of a chase without waiting for a cooldown or a long reposition. A survivor who builds a defensive plan around one form is suddenly facing a completely different set of threats, which breaks predictable loop patterns.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Shift into Wolf Form when a chase is going long and the killer needs to cover ground faster or cross a gap the vampire form cannot handle. Drop back to Vampire Form when the killer has caught up and wants to punish a survivor hiding behind a pallet with Hellfire.

Item_Slasher_K38Power.name: Scent of Blood
Item_Slasher_K38Power.description:
The Houndmaster and her dog operate as one. Her commands are followed without question or delay.

SPECIAL ABILITY: CHASE

The Chase Command sends the dog out at high speed. Pressing the Power button again redirects the Chase, pivoting the dog's path. When the dog catches a Survivor, the dog starts a Grab. The Survivor becomes Hindered and is pulled toward The Houndmaster. The Survivor can get free by stunning the dog or can be rescued by another Survivor. Grabs that end without injury leave the Survivor Hindered. Grab duration is shorter for Survivors with the Endurance status effect.

SPECIAL ABILITY: SEARCH

The Search Command sends the dog to a target location, creating a Search Path. It has its own lullaby and, as it moves, its Houndsense radius rises over distance traveled. Survivors who enter the radius are affected by Houndsense and revealed by Killer Instinct. If The Houndmaster follows the dog’s Search Path, she gains increased movement speed over time. Leaving the Search Path ends the bonus movement speed.

SPECIAL EFFECT: HOUNDSENSE

Healthy Survivors affected by Houndsense receive Deep Wounds when injured. Injured Survivors affected by Houndsense suffer from louder grunts of pain and longer pools of blood when put into the dying sta
Item_Slasher_K38Power.summary: The Houndmaster and her dog operate as one. Her commands are followed without question or delay.

beginner.whatItIs: Scent of Blood is The Houndmaster's power, which sends her dog sprinting after a target the moment the Chase command is issued. Pressing the Power button again pivots the dog's path, and when the dog catches a survivor it begins a Grab that pulls them toward The Houndmaster while applying Hindered.
beginner.whyItMatters: The dog acts as a second pursuer that crosses open ground at high speed, which forces survivors to run in a direction the killer chose rather than one they chose. A Grab that ends without injury still costs time and space, and the survivor must either stun the dog or rely on a teammate to break free.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Send the dog the moment a survivor commits to a long sprint across open ground, since the dog's speed is highest over distance and the Grab lands before a pallet is in reach. Redirect the chase by pressing the Power button again if the survivor is about to turn a corner, so the dog keeps pressure on their escape route.

Item_Slasher_K39Power.name: One-Eyed Terror
Item_Slasher_K39Power.description:
SPECIAL ABILITY: Kagune Leap

Use the Power button to charge and launch the Kagune, tentacles that attach to any vertical surface within range and quickly pull The Ghoul forward.

After completing a leap, The Ghoul has a window to perform a second consecutive Kagune Leap or put Kagune Leap into cooldown by using the Active Ability button.

Kagune Leap enters cooldown once The Ghoul has consumed their leaps, if they leap and special-vault a window or dropped pallet, or if the Kagune grabs and leaps at a Survivor.

If The Ghoul's second consecutive leap targets a Survivor, they will perform a grab-attack. Grab-attacks damage Survivors if they are healthy; inflict Deep Wounds; and leave a Kagune Mark.

Performing a grab-attack also triggers Enraged Mode.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Enraged Mode

While Enraged, The Ghoul can perform up to three consecutive Kagune Leaps and can special-vault faster if they launch their Kagune at a Survivor.

Enraged Mode remains active while there are Survivors afflicted with Kagune Mark. Marked Survivors will lose their mark if they are fully mended, or if they are downed.

The Ghoul cannot grab-attack marked Survivors.

Once no marked Survivors remain, a Countdown begins. When the Countdown depletes, Enraged Mode ends. A perfectly timed grab-attack - tapping the attack button when the attack icon is displayed - will add extra time to the Countdown. The Countdown is paused while carrying Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: One-Eyed Terror is The Ghoul's power, built around Kagune Leap, which charges and then launches tentacles to grab a nearby vertical surface and yank The Ghoul forward. After each leap there is a short window to chain a second leap before the ability enters cooldown.
beginner.whyItMatters: Kagune Leap lets The Ghoul close distance over obstacles that would normally slow a chase, such as low walls or gaps between buildings. Chaining two leaps back to back covers a much larger span of the map in one continuous motion, which can turn a losing chase into a catch.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Charge Kagune Leap when a survivor is vaulting a wall or dropping through a window, since the leap closes the gap before they hit the ground on the far side. Save the second leap for the moment the first one lands and the survivor is still turning, so the chained leap catches them before they can reset their route.

Item_Slasher_K40Power.name: Fazbear's Fright
Item_Slasher_K40Power.description:
The Animatronic lived to kill, even when his mechanical costume became his tomb.

SPECIAL ABILITY: FIRE AXE

The Animatronic is armed with a Fire Axe that he can throw at Survivors. If the Fire Axe hits a Survivor, the weapon becomes embedded in them, afflicting them with Broken & Oblivious until it is removed.

SPECIAL MAP FEATURE: SECURITY SYSTEM

At the start of the trial, 7 Security Doors are spawned randomly throughout the map. These Doors can be accessed by both Survivors and The Animatronic.

Each Security Door has a Camera attached to it. Interacting with the Door gives the Survivor access to the Camera View, allowing the Survivor to cycle through every Camera in the map, travel to the Door they are currently looking through, and potentially reveal The Animatronic's aura to the team.

Using the Cameras and Doors too often will deplete the limited battery power available, forcing Survivors to wait until the system reboots. The Animatronic may travel between Security Doors with or without battery power.

If The Animatronic enters a Security Door, they may choose to exit from any other Door in the map. Moving to a Door already in use by a Survivor will cause The Animatronic to grab that Survivor.

Upon entering a Security Door, The Animatronic gains the Undetectable status effect. The effect lasts 20 seconds after exiting a Security Door, or until revealed by a Survivor on a Security Cam
Item_Slasher_K40Power.summary: The Animatronic lived to kill, even when his mechanical costume became his tomb.

beginner.whatItIs: The Animatronic hurls a Fire Axe at a survivor, and a clean hit embeds the blade in them, leaving the target afflicted with Broken & Oblivious until they work it out. The power also seeds Security Doors onto the map at trial start, creating choke points that both sides can trigger to seal or open a passage.
beginner.whyItMatters: An embedded axe pins a debuff to the survivor for a stretch, stealing clean reactions and making their escape decisions less reliable while The Animatronic closes the gap. The Security Doors add a layer of map control, letting the killer seal a corridor at the worst moment and force survivors to reroute around a blocked path.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Throw the Fire Axe when a survivor is mid-vault or looping a pallet, since they have less room to react to the added affliction. Pair it with a nearby Security Door so the moment the axe embeds the killer can seal the escape and force a second chase from behind.

Item_Slasher_K41Power.name: Unbodied Flesh
Item_Slasher_K41Power.description:
SPECIAL ABILITY: CORPOREAL WEAVE

The Krasue can shift between Body and Head Forms at will.

Body Form has a 32-meter Terror Radius. Head Form has a 40-meter Terror Radius. It is slightly faster, can special-vault, but cannot break dropped pallets or gain Bloodlust in chase.

SPECIAL EFFECT: LEECHED

Hitting a Survivor with Intestinal Whip or a Leeching Gland adds to their Leech Meter. When the meter is filled, the Survivor is afflicted with Leeched I.Leeched I: The Leech Meter fills automatically.Leeched II: The Survivor is afflicted with Broken. If healthy, they become injured.

SPECIAL ABILITY: INTESTINAL WHIP

In Head Form, press the Attack button to lash out with your internal organs.

Survivors afflicted with Leeched can be damaged by Intestinal Whip.Intestinal Whip partially fills a Survivor’s Leech Meter, up to Leech I.

SPECIAL ABILITY: REGURGITATE

In Body Form, press and hold the Power button to charge Regurgitate. When charged, tap the Attack button to spew a Leeching Gland.Leeching Gland completely fills a Survivor’s Leech Meter, up to Leech I.

SPECIAL ITEM: GLOWING FUNGUS

Survivors can eat Glowing Fungus to decrease the Leech Meter over time. Being hit ends the effect.

SPECIAL ABILITY: HEADLONG FLIGHT

In Head Form, press and hold the Power button to speed through the air.

beginner.whatItIs: The Krasue's power, Corporeal Weave, toggles between a full Body Form and a detached Head Form, each carrying a different Terror Radius and a different set of chase tools. Head Form trades pallet-breaking and Bloodlust for extra speed and a special vault, while the Intestinal Whip or Leeching Gland builds a Leech Meter that, when full, afflicts the survivor with Leeched.
beginner.whyItMatters: Switching to Head Form mid-chase lets the Krasue outpace a survivor who tries to cut through a pallet or window without losing momentum, collapsing the gap that normally saves them. The Leech Meter rewards landing repeated hits across a trial, so a patient killer who keeps the pressure on will see the debuff snowball into a long punishment window.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Shift to Head Form the moment a survivor breaks a pallet and sprints toward a window, because the extra speed and special vault let the Krasue follow through without stalling. Keep Intestinal Whip or Leeching Gland swings in rotation so the Leech Meter fills before the survivor reaches a generator, locking in Leeched at the worst possible moment for them.

Item_Slasher_K42Power.name: Test Subject #001
Item_Slasher_K42Power.description:
SPECIAL ABILITY: VINE ATTACK

Press and hold the Power button to charge a Vine Attack. When charged, press the Attack button to activate it, creating a small area of effect on the ground.

Any Survivors caught within the area of the Vine Attack earn a Worldbreaker token.

SPECIAL ABILITY: THE UPSIDE DOWN & UNDERGATE
