The Killer can enter The Upside Down to navigate the map quickly by tapping the Ability button. While in The Upside Down, the Killer can activate an Undergate attack to return to the map, creating a large area of effect on the ground. Survivors caught within its radius gain 2 Worldbreaker tokens.

SPECIAL CONDITION/ITEM: WORLDBREAKER & GRANDFATHER CLOCKS

Once a Survivor has gained enough tokens, Worldbreaker activates, and the Worldbreaker Timer begins. While Worldbreaker is active, both the Vine Attack and Undergate attacks do damage to Survivors instead of adding Worldbreaker tokens, and 4 Grandfather Clocks activate.

Worldbreaker lasts for a predetermined amount of time, based on the number of Survivors alive. Survivors can interact with the Grandfather Clocks spread around the map to speed up the Worldbreaker Timer.

beginner.whatItIs: Pressing and holding the Power button charges a Vine Attack, which on release carves a small area on the ground that tags any survivor caught inside with a Worldbreaker token. A separate ability, The Upside Down & Undergate, lets the Killer slip into a hidden network to cross the map quickly and then burst back out through an Undergate attack.
beginner.whyItMatters: The Worldbreaker token can distort a survivor's perception of what is safe, making their escape decisions less reliable exactly when the Killer needs them to hesitate. The Upside Down lets the Killer collapse distance that would normally save a survivor, popping out behind the next target without running the long way across the map.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Charge the Vine Attack just before a survivor drops to a generator, so the Worldbreaker token lands right as their focus is already split between the repair and watching for the killer. Use The Upside Down to close the gap after a generator completes, appearing through an Undergate directly behind the next target instead of tracking them across the entire map.

Item_Slasher_Kanobo.name: Yamaoka's Wrath
Item_Slasher_Kanobo.description:
The desire to destroy weaker bloodlines shaped into a literal force.

YAMAOKA'S WRATH

Absorb Blood Orbs left by your injured foes. Press and hold the Power button to absorb Blood Orbs in the environment and fill your power gauge. When your power gauge is full, press and hold the Active Ability button to initiate Blood Fury.

Blood Fury: While Blood Fury is active, The Oni becomes lethal and gains access to additional abilities: Demon Dash and Demon Strike.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Demon Dash

Press and hold the Power button while Blood Fury is active to perform a Demon Dash. This ability allows The Oni to cover large distances at high speed.

SPECIAL ATTACK: Demon Strike

Press and hold the Attack button while Blood Fury is active to perform a Demon Strike in the direction you are facing. Demon Strike has an extended lunge range and successful hits immediately put healthy Survivors into the dying state. Hitting a dropped pallet or breakable wall will special-break it.
Item_Slasher_Kanobo.summary: The desire to destroy weaker bloodlines shaped into a literal force.

beginner.whatItIs: Yamaoka's Wrath lets The Oni absorb Blood Orbs dropped by injured survivors to fill a power gauge over time. Once the gauge is full, The Oni steps into Blood Fury, becoming lethal and gaining access to Demon Dash and Demon Strike for a limited burst of aggression.
beginner.whyItMatters: Blood Fury turns a normal chase into a lethal scramble because every swing can kill rather than merely injure, collapsing the recovery window a survivor normally relies on to vault or hide. The gauge builds passively from the environment, so the power rewards a killer who keeps churning clean hits and lets the Orbs accumulate between chases.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Let the power gauge build during a slow generator phase where clean hits are landing, then step into Blood Fury the moment a survivor drops to a generator and the crouch needs punishing. Demon Dash is the tool to cross open ground or cut off a vault, while Demon Strike closes the gap when a survivor is already boxed in.

Item_Slasher_Killer07Item.name: Carter's Spark
Item_Slasher_Killer07Item.description:
CARTER'S SPARK

Successfully striking Survivors with The Doctor's special abilities, Shock Therapy or Static Blast, increases the Survivor's Madness, eventually afflicting them with the Madness status effect and triggering increasingly potent effects.

Madness I:

Causes Survivors to scream once, revealing their position to The Doctor. Slightly affects Skill Check placement and direction.

Madness II:

Causes Survivors to scream once and experience hallucinations in the form of an illusionary Doctor. Moderately affects Skill Check placement and direction.

Madness III:

Causes Survivors to scream intermittently and experience hallucinations in the form of an illusionary Doctor. Tremendously affects Skill Check placement and direction. The Survivor cannot heal, repair, sabotage, unlock, cleanse, or use items until they successfully Snap Out Of It. When a Survivor completes the Snap Out Of It action, they return to Madness I.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Shock Therapy

Press and hold the Power button to perform Shock Therapy, unleashing a ranged shock attack on the ground in front of you. Survivors struck by Shock Therapy gain increased Madness and any interactions they are performing are immediately interrupted. Shock Therapy immediately negates the Oblivious status effect.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Static Blast

Press and hold the Active Ability button to perform a Static Blast, causing all Survivors within The Doctor's Terror Radius to scream and gain increased Madness. Static Blast can only be activated when not on cooldown. Static Blast immediately negates the Oblivious status effect.

beginner.whatItIs: Carter's Spark is the engine behind The Doctor's Shock Therapy and Static Blast, both of which build a Madness meter on the survivor they hit. As Madness climbs, the target starts to scream and sees hallucinatory copies of The Doctor, with the disorienting effects growing stronger as the meter fills.
beginner.whyItMatters: A survivor suffering from high Madness is harder to track reliably because their screams leak position and their skill checks wobble, making vaulting and generator repair slower and more visible. The stacking nature means one clean hit in a chase can set up a much longer punishment window than a standard injure would.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Land Shock Therapy or Static Blast early in a chase to start the Madness climb while the survivor is still trying to escape, so the hallucinations and position-leaking screams kick in before they reach a generator. The power shines most when a survivor is looping the same tile, since each repeated hit pushes the meter higher and the disorientation compounds with every swing.

Item_Slasher_LFChainsaw.name: Bubba's Chainsaw
Item_Slasher_LFChainsaw.description:
The Cannibal starts the trial with 3 charges. Press and hold the Power button to consume one charge and perform a Chainsaw Sweep attack that can hit multiple targets. Survivors hit during a Chainsaw Sweep are put into the dying state. Hitting a dropped pallet or breakable wall will special-break it.

Use a charge to extend the length of the Chainsaw Sweep. Doing this incurs a slightly longer cooldown. Chainsaw charges replenish when the chainsaw is not in use.

The Tantrum Meter slowly fills when revving the Chainsaw. Once the meter is full, or after hitting an object during a Chainsaw Sweep, The Cannibal unleashes a Tantrum. The Tantrum damages any Survivor’s around him and puts them into the dying state.

The Tantrum duration increases for each charge that had been used during the Chainsaw Sweep. Any remaining charges are lost. During a Tantrum, movement speed is decreased.The Tantrum Meter decreases when the Chainsaw is not in use and completely depletes during a Chainsaw Sweep.
Item_Slasher_LFChainsaw.summary: The Cannibal starts the trial with 3 charges. Press and hold the Power button to consume one charge and perform a Chainsaw Sweep attack that can hit multiple targets. Survivors hit during a Chainsaw Sweep are put into the dying state. Hitting a dropped pallet or breakable wall will special-break it.

beginner.whatItIs: The Cannibal holds a limited pool of Chainsaw Sweep charges, each consumed by pressing and holding the Power button to swing a wide, lethal arc that can hit multiple survivors at once. The sweep also special-breaks dropped pallets and breakable walls it passes through, and a Tantrum Meter slowly builds the more the chainsaw is abused.
beginner.whyItMatters: A single sweep can injure or kill several survivors in one motion, which is enormous when a chase splits across a corridor and the killer wants to punish everyone at once. The Tantrum Meter means the more the chainsaw is spammed, the more the Cannibal's own state deteriorates, so overusing it backfires and leaves the killer vulnerable.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Save a sweep for the moment a survivor vaults through a window and the killer is already committed, because the wide arc punishes the extra distance they gain. Do not burn a charge on a single survivor who is still in front of a generator; wait until they break the pallet or vault so the sweep can follow them into the next tile.

Item_Slasher_PhantomTrap.name: Blackened Catalyst
Item_Slasher_PhantomTrap.description:
The source of The Hag's power, a blackened finger used as a catalyst for her terrible power. The Hag bends and shapes mud to her will. With simple ritualistic drawings, she creates deceitful duplicates of herself made from mud and decay which she can use for various effects.

Grants the ability to create and maintain 10 Phantasm Traps.Grants the ability to instantly travel to triggered Phantasm Traps when within a 48 meter range.
Item_Slasher_PhantomTrap.summary: The source of The Hag's power, a blackened finger used as a catalyst for her terrible power. The Hag bends and shapes mud to her will. With simple ritualistic drawings, she creates deceitful duplicates of herself made from mud and decay which she can use for various effects.

beginner.whatItIs: Blackened Catalyst is The Hag's blackened finger, used as a catalyst for sculpting mud duplicates called Phantasm Traps across the map. She can maintain several of these traps simultaneously, and if one is triggered while she is within range she can blink to its location instantly.
beginner.whyItMatters: A Phantasm Trap in the wrong place can yank The Hag across half the map in an instant, turning a long reposition into a free teleport the moment a survivor triggers the mud. The cost is patience: traps are finite and must be re-placed, so a careless trigger wastes a resource that could have carried the killer to the next chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Place a Phantasm Trap near a generator cluster or a known survivor loop before the chase even starts, so the trigger fires at the exact moment a survivor dashes past. Hold the travel for the split-second after a generator completes, when the next target is predictable and the blink drops The Hag right on top of them.

Item_Slasher_PhaseWalker.name: Yamaoka’s Haunting
Item_Slasher_PhaseWalker.description:
The Spirit can use her power, Yamaoka’s Haunting, to enter an ethereal plane and reappear at a new location.

Tap and Hold the Power button to charge. The Spirit will depart her physical body, leaving behind a stationary 'husk'.

While Yamaoka’s Haunting is active:The Spirit may traverse freely to a new location, moving at a faster rate for a short duration. She is still confined to movement within the physical environments and surroundings.The Spirit leaves the physical plane, losing sight of all Survivors. She can, however, still sense the scratch marks they leave in the environment.The Spirit will produce an audible cue at her current location.Once the power has ended, The Spirit retains her speed boost for a brief period and her husk fades away.

Using Yamaoka’s Haunting depletes The Spirit's power bar. The power bar will automatically replenish over time. The power bar must be fully replenished before it can be triggered again.
Item_Slasher_PhaseWalker.summary: The Spirit can use her power, Yamaoka’s Haunting, to enter an ethereal plane and reappear at a new location.

beginner.whatItIs: Yamaoka's Haunting lifts The Spirit out of the physical plane, leaving a stationary husk behind while her body drifts freely to a new location at a faster pace. While active she cannot be seen by survivors and her movement is constrained to the physical environment's layout.
beginner.whyItMatters: The ethereal traversal collapses the distance between chases, letting The Spirit appear on the other side of a building before survivors can react to her reposition. The tradeoff is that she is blind to the physical world while phased, so a survivor who notices the husk can walk past it without triggering a chase.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Trigger Yamaoka's Haunting when a chase is stalling near a generator loop and a survivor is closing in, since the brief speed boost lets The Spirit cover the distance to a new hunting area faster than they can follow. Hold the power button to charge, then commit once the husk is left behind, because the husk stays stationary and any survivor nearby will spot exactly where the departure happened. Save the reposition for open ground separating distant structures rather than tight corridors, where the faster movement rate gives an edge over a pursuing survivor.

Item_Slasher_PlaguePower.name: Vile Purge
Item_Slasher_PlaguePower.description:
Her condition deteriorated as the plague overtook her body: her toes blackened, her neck mushroomed into cysts, and her throat gagged with bloody vomit.

VILE PURGE

Infect environmental objects and Survivors with Vile Purge to create an unending cycle of sickness. Press and hold the Power button to charge Vile Purge, and release the button to unleash a stream of infectious bile. Hitting a Survivor will cause them to become infected. Hitting an environmental object will cause it to become infected for a short time. Survivors interacting with infected objects will also become infected.

When a Survivor's infection indicator is completely filled, The Survivor is put into the injured state, is afflicted by the Broken status effect, and forced to vomit at random intervals.

SPECIAL ABILITY: INGEST CORRUPTION

Infected Survivors can heal themselves to full health and cure their infection by cleansing at a Pool of Devotion. This action corrupts the pool, allowing The Plague to consume the corruption and empower her purge. Press and hold the Interaction button while next to a corrupt Pool of Devotion to transform Vile Purge into Corrupt Purge. This action removes the corruption from the pool.

SPECIAL ATTACK: CORRUPT PURGE

After using the Ingest Corruption ability, Vile Purge is replaced by Corrupt Purge for a short duration. Corrupt Purge instantly damages any Survivor hit by its stream, however, it no longer applies infection to Survivors or environmental objects.
Item_Slasher_PlaguePower.summary: Her condition deteriorated as the plague overtook her body: her toes blackened, her neck mushroomed into cysts, and her throat gagged with bloody vomit.

beginner.whatItIs: Vile Purge is a charged stream of infectious bile that, on release, infects either a survivor or an environmental object with a spreading sickness. Infected survivors pass the condition to nearby objects, and infected objects in turn spread it to survivors who interact with them, creating a self-sustaining cycle.
beginner.whyItMatters: Once a single object is tainted, every survivor who touches it becomes a new vector, so a generator repair or a pallet vault can quietly seed the whole area without the killer landing another direct hit. The cycle is hard to break because survivors cannot see the infection spreading, and by the time they realize something is wrong multiple tiles are already compromised.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Release the bile on a generator that is already half complete, so the infection lands at the exact moment survivors are most committed to finishing the repair. Target objects near vault points or pallet corridors where survivors will pass through them repeatedly, letting the cycle spread on its own without the killer needing to chase down every new host.

Item_Slasher_QatarKillerPower.name: Of the Abyss
Item_Slasher_QatarKillerPower.description:
An unknown and otherworldly power surged through its body. Suddenly the ground ripped open, swallowing The Demogorgon whole.

OF THE ABYSS

Press and hold the Power button to fully charge and activate Of the Abyss. All Survivors within a close proximity to an activated Portal will be indicated by Killer Instinct.

SPECIAL ATTACK: SHRED

Press the Attack button while charging or holding Of the Abyss to dive forward and unleash a vicious slash. Hitting a dropped pallet or breakable wall will special-break it.

SPECIAL ABILITY: PORTALS

Press the Active Ability button to open a Portal on the ground in front of you.

Traverse Upside Down:

While standing on a placed Portal with a different Portal highlighted, press the Active Ability button again to travel through the Upside Down to arrive at the targeted Portal. Emerging from a Portal grants Undetectable.

Activated Portals:

Portals become 'activated' when they are first traversed to or from. Only activated Portals may be sealed by Survivors. Activated Portal auras are highlighted in yellow.
Item_Slasher_QatarKillerPower.summary: An unknown and otherworldly power surged through its body. Suddenly the ground ripped open, swallowing The Demogorgon whole.

beginner.whatItIs: Of the Abyss is a charged power that, when fully activated, opens a Portal close to The Demogorgon and marks every survivor in that area with Killer Instinct. A special attack called Shred lets The Demogorgon dive forward through a dropped pallet or breakable wall while the power is active.
beginner.whyItMatters: The Portal marks survivors for a window of time, making them visible through walls and obstacles, which strips away the cover a chaser relies on to shake the killer. Shred adds a tool to cut through a dropped pallet mid-chase, collapsing the one escape mechanic that normally saves a survivor at the last second.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Activate Of the Abyss when a group of survivors is clustered near a generator, so the Killer Instinct marks them all at once and the chase does not end when one breaks a pallet. Follow up with Shred the instant a survivor drops a pallet in their escape path, because the special-break removes their only cover and puts The Demogorgon directly behind them.

Item_Slasher_ReverseBearTrap.name: Jigsaw's Baptism
Item_Slasher_ReverseBearTrap.description:
Forever devoted to her master's cause, she punishes the ungrateful and the guilty with slyness and murderous puzzles. The Pig can move stealthily, dash in Ambush attacks and put deadly Reverse Bear Traps on Survivors' heads.

JIGSAW'S BAPTISM

Start the trial with 4 inactive Reverse Bear Traps. While standing over a Survivor in the dying state, press the Active Ability button to place an inactive Reverse Bear Trap on The Survivor. Reverse Bear Traps become active when any generator in the trial is completed. Survivors may attempt to free themselves from active or inactive Reverse Bear Traps by searching Jigsaw Boxes located in the environment to find the correct key.

Active Reverse Bear Traps:

When Reverse Bear Traps become active, they initiate a countdown timer. A Survivor with an active Reverse Bear Trap is automatically sacrificed when their timer expires or if they attempt to leave the trial with an active Reverse Bear Trap still attached.

SPECIAL ABILITY: CROUCH

Press the Active Ability button to Crouch. Press the Active Ability button again while Crouched to stand. The Pig moves at a slower speed while Crouched. The Pig is granted the Undetectable status effect while Crouched.

SPECIAL ATTACK: AMBUSH

Press and hold the Attack button while Crouched to dash and perform an Ambush attack.
Item_Slasher_ReverseBearTrap.summary: Forever devoted to her master's cause, she punishes the ungrateful and the guilty with slyness and murderous puzzles. The Pig can move stealthily, dash in Ambush attacks and put deadly Reverse Bear Traps on Survivors' heads.

beginner.whatItIs: Jigsaw's Baptism gives The Pig a set of Reverse Bear Traps that settle onto a downed survivor's head and snap shut once a generator reaches a progress milestone. It also grants quiet movement and a short burst of speed that turns into an Ambush attack mid-chase.
beginner.whyItMatters: Reverse Bear Traps stay dormant until a generator in the trial progresses, so a downed survivor cannot escape by simply waiting. Stealth movement closes distance without being heard, and the Ambush dash punishes any survivor who bolts in panic from a downed state.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Press the power button while standing over a downed survivor, ideally when a nearby generator is close to completing so the trap activates before a rescue is possible. Pair it with stealth to reach a survivor quietly and drop them, then lock them in place with the trap.

Item_Slasher_Stalker.name: Evil Within
Item_Slasher_Stalker.description:
The Shape stalks his prey, adapting to the pursuit, waiting for the perfect moment to unleash evil.

The Shape can switch between three modes of hunting his prey. Each mode has different strengths and weaknesses.

SPECIAL MODE: STALKER

The Shape moves slowly and is Undetectable. In Stalker mode, press and hold the Power button to Stalk a nearby Survivor and fill the Stalk Meter. When the Stalk Meter is full, Evil Incarnate mode is unlocked.

SPECIAL MODE: PURSUER

The Shape moves quickly and has a 16 meter Terror Radius. Vault, basic-break, lunge, and stun recovery speeds are increased.

SPECIAL MODE: EVIL INCARNATE

The Shape’s Terror Radius is increased to 32 meters. Vault, basic-break, and stun recovery speeds are increased. Survivors who have reached the second hook stage can be killed.Evil Incarnate mode ends after 60 seconds.

SPECIAL ABILITY: SLAUGHTERING STRIKE

In Evil Incarnate mode, hold the Power button to charge Slaughtering Strike and press the Attack button to unleash it. The longer the Power button is held, the more distance on the attack. Survivors hit by Slaughtering Strike are downed, even if healthy. Hitting a dropped pallet or breakable wall will special-break it.
Item_Slasher_Stalker.summary: The Shape stalks his prey, adapting to the pursuit, waiting for the perfect moment to unleash evil.

beginner.whatItIs: The Shape hunts in multiple switchable modes, each with different strengths and weaknesses. In Stalker mode, The Shape is Undetectable and moves slowly, holding the power button to fill a Stalk Meter that unlocks Evil Incarnate mode.
beginner.whyItMatters: Stalker mode grants total silence and Undetectable movement, so survivors hear nothing and see nothing until The Shape strikes. Filling the Stalk Meter unlocks Evil Incarnate mode, and switching to Pursuer mode gives The Shape the raw speed to catch a target that breaks away.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Drop into Stalker mode when a survivor is in an open area with no generators nearby, hold the power button until the Stalk Meter is full, then enter Evil Incarnate mode or switch to Pursuer to close the distance. It rewards waiting for the right moment rather than chasing blindly.

Item_Slasher_ThrowingKnives.name: Showstopper
Item_Slasher_ThrowingKnives.description:
SPECIAL ABILITY: BLADE THROW

Press and hold the Power button to enter the Throw State. Tap the Attack button to throw a single Blade, or hold down to unleash a flurry of Blades. Restock Blades at Lockers.

SPECIAL EFFECT: LACERATION

Survivors' Laceration Meter increases when hit by Blades. When the meter is filled, they lose a health state. Laceration decreases after a delay if Survivors are not hit by Blades. Injuring Survivors with basic attacks decreases Laceration.

SPECIAL ABILITY: STYLE POINTS & STYLE RANKS

By throwing Blades, injuring Survivors and performing distinct actions back-to-back, The Trickster earns Style Points. Regular actions give few Style Points, while skillful actions give more.

Earning Style Points causes The Trickster to go up in Style Ranks. Each Style Rank improves his Blade throw and restocking speed. Earning Style Points refreshes the current Style Rank timer.

SPECIAL CONDITION/ABILITY: S-RANK & MAIN EVENT

At S-Rank, The Trickster gains a 44-meter Terror radius, the Lullaby is disabled, Laceration Meters decay blocked, Blade throw and restock speeds increase further, and he can trigger Main Event.

Main Event is activated by pressing the Ability button, causing The Trickster to throw unlimited Blades at high speed. Each Blade hitting Survivors awards bonus Style Points. End Main Event early by pressing the Ability button. Main Event ending triggers fatigue.

Main Event cannot be activated near hooked Survivors.

beginner.whatItIs: Holding the power button enters a Throw State where tapping the attack button fires a single Blade and holding unleashes a flurry. Blades restock at Lockers, and every hit a survivor takes from Blades builds their Laceration Meter.
beginner.whyItMatters: Laceration builds with each Blade hit, so a survivor caught in the open takes mounting damage without a single full melee hit landing. The tradeoff is that a basic attack in the same sequence reduces Laceration, so a killer who mixes in melee sacrifices the bleed pressure for the certainty of a direct health hit.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Enter Throw State in an open corridor or across a courtyard where a survivor has no cover, then unleash the full flurry to build Laceration quickly. Restock at a Locker before committing to the next chase so the Blades are ready when the survivor reappears.

Item_Slasher_TormentMode.name: Rites of Judgment
Item_Slasher_TormentMode.description:
Open the gates of suffering and be judged! The Great Knife splits the ground, giving rise to an infernal construct and spreading agony to all who approach.

RITES OF JUDGMENT

Hold the Power button to activate, then move in any direction to carve a trail into the ground.

Survivors who walk or run on the trail will trigger Killer Instinct and be afflicted with Torment. Survivors affected by Torment may be sent to a Cage of Atonement while they are in the dying state.

SPECIAL ATTACK: Punishment of the Damned

Press the Attack button while Rites of Judgment is active to perform Punishment of the Damned. This unleashes a wave of force, damaging any Survivors in its path.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Cage of Atonement

Press the Active Ability button while standing over a dying Survivor suffering from Torment to send them to a Cage of Atonement. Survivors in a Cage of Atonement can be sacrificed as if they were on a hook. During the second phase of the summoning ritual they will be forced to complete Skill Checks to hold off The Entity.

Being rescued or rescuing another Survivor from a Cage of Atonement will remove Torment.

SPECIAL ABILITY: Final Judgment

Press the Active Ability button when standing over a dying Survivor suffering from Torment who has already reached struggle phase on a hook or in a cage to execute them.
Item_Slasher_TormentMode.summary: Open the gates of suffering and be judged! The Great Knife splits the ground, giving rise to an infernal construct and spreading agony to all who approach.

beginner.whatItIs: Holding the Power button and walking splits the ground into a trail behind The Executioner. Stepping onto it, at a walk or at a run, sets off Killer Instinct and leaves Torment behind. A tormented survivor who goes down can be sent to a Cage of Atonement instead of a hook.
beginner.whyItMatters: The trail turns a stretch of ground into a persistent danger zone, so survivors must alter their routes or take the hit to cross. Torment adds a second layer of punishment beyond the initial damage, and the Cage of Atonement locks a downed survivor in place, denying a rescue.
beginner.whenToUseIt: Carve the trail across a corridor or open path a survivor is likely to cross, catching them mid-sprint before they can react. Apply it after a drop to afflict the survivor with Torment and commit them to the Cage of Atonement while they are dying.
